newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Manager of Romania Azomures resigns.
newsitem.headline: Manager of Romania Azomures resigns.

text.p: The Bucharest stock exchange said on Monday listed fertiliser maker Azomures SA had accepted the resignation of its general manager, who also gave up membership of the company's management team.

The resignation of former general manager Oleg Jelezniac was accepted by Azomures' general meeting of shareholders, who also approved appointment by the management team of Vasile Urdea as the new general manager, a bourse statement said.
It did not say why Jelezniac resigned, but said he would stay with Azomures as adviser to the general manager.
Before his appointment, Urdea was the company's technical manager.
Brokers did not expect the market to react to the news.
Azomures, the only of the exchange's 19 stocks to trade on the first tier thanks to its fine performance, closed last week 2,200 lei stronger at 29,900. ($=6,183 lei)
